_comment: Portable template. Copy to an ignored local file, replace every /path/to placeholder with a physical absolute path, keep it 0600. The lease path must be shared by every checkout that uses this auth source and live outside all checkouts; the first managed command binds it in the canonical auth home.

dev._comment: Plain Codex consumers (account-probe, codex exec, app-server clients that select no permission profile): tool commands are denied the canonical auth home, the run's auth link, the lease directory, every extra_denied_paths entry and the role's deny_paths; read_paths re-open subpaths of the role's own denies only. A codex command line that selects another sandbox or permission source, or a working or added directory inside a deny, is refused before launch.

native-task._comment: Requires supervisor 1.4.0 or later. Replace the write root with the exact physical task cwd and the read roots with only its declared common runtime directories; keep gold and private evaluator material outside these grants. Select gptgrep_codex_auth in the native consumer. Auth, lease and run auth-link denies remain enforced.

native-network-task._comment: Optional exact-domain tool network with managed proxy and web search disabled. This allows the host, not a particular endpoint or model. Use identical domains for comparison arms; allow_openrouter and OPENROUTER_API_KEY passthrough are a separate explicit treatment-role choice. Use the proxy address injected into tool commands at runtime. Replace physical runtime/task paths and qualify the native consumer's unchanged profile before use.

eval-baseline._comment: GPTgrep native roles select their own deny-root permission profiles; the supervisor records this as unverified.

harbor._comment: Launch the Harbor executable directly (never a wrapper that re-exports the shared CODEX_HOME) with --harbor-job-label gptgrep.auth-job=<full62 runtime run_id>. On cancel or deadline Harbor alone gets SIGTERM and 300 s to remove its containers. OPENROUTER_API_KEY stays blocked until the separate OpenRouter path is approved; then add it here with allow_openrouter=true for the treatment launcher only.
